data_description.api_key: An admin-scope key from Kinwall Settings → API keys. Needed to register the push webhook.

abort.already_configured: This Kinwall server is already configured

data.chore_points: Points for chores created from Home Assistant

external_url_required.title: Kinwall can't push updates to Home Assistant
external_url_required.description: Kinwall at {url} is not on your local network, so it can only reach Home Assistant through an external URL. Set one under Settings → System → Network → Home Assistant URL → Internet, then reload the Kinwall integration. Until then the integration polls every 30 seconds instead.

import_recipe.name: Import recipe
import_recipe.description: Adds a recipe from another app (such as a meal kit) to Kinwall's recipe library, or updates it if it was imported before, and optionally plans it. Needs an admin API key.

config_entry.name: Kinwall
config_entry.description: Which Kinwall, when more than one is set up.

source.name: Source
source.description: Where the recipe comes from. With the ID, it identifies the recipe, so importing it again updates it.

external_id.name: Recipe ID
external_id.description: The source's own ID for the recipe.

source_url.name: Recipe card link
source_url.description: Link to the recipe card, saved as the recipe's source link.

image_url.name: Image link
image_url.description: Link to a photo of the dish.

servings.name: Servings
servings.description: How many servings the ingredient amounts are for.

ingredients.name: Ingredients
ingredients.description: A list of lines like "1.5 tablespoon Sour Cream", or objects with text, pantry and category. pantry: false means it ships in the kit, so grocery lists leave it off.

steps.name: Steps
steps.description: A list of steps: text (a step of several lines becomes bullets), or objects with text, bullets (a list), image_url (the step's photo), title (or caption: a short heading for the step) and timers (a list of name and minutes). Step titles and timers need a Kinwall server newer than 1.0.2.

plan_date.name: Plan on
plan_date.description: Also plan the recipe on this date, unless that slot already has a meal. The response says whether it was planned.

plan_slot.name: Plan for
plan_slot.description: Which meal of the day to plan it for.

plan_servings.name: Planned servings
plan_servings.description: Servings for the planned meal. Defaults to the recipe's.

plan_calendar_id.name: Add to calendar
plan_calendar_id.description: A Kinwall calendar ID (Kinwall Settings → Calendars, tap the calendar: it's at the bottom). The planned meal also goes on that calendar at its usual meal time, unless it already has an event. Synced calendars work too. Leave empty for no event.

sync_events.name: Sync events
sync_events.description: Keeps a set of events on a Kinwall calendar: adds the new ones, updates the changed ones and removes the ones from this source that are missing. Events made in Kinwall are never changed. Only for calendars made in Kinwall (not synced ones). Needs an admin API key and a Kinwall server newer than 1.0.2.

config_entry.name: Kinwall
config_entry.description: Which Kinwall, when more than one is set up.

calendar_id.name: Calendar ID
calendar_id.description: A Kinwall calendar ID (Kinwall Settings → Calendars, tap the calendar: it's at the bottom). It must be a calendar made in Kinwall.

source.name: Source
source.description: Names this set of events, like ha:hellofresh. A sync only adds, changes or removes events from its own source.

from.name: From
from.description: With To: only events of this source starting in this window are removed when missing, so past ones stay. Leave both empty to replace every event of this source.

to.name: To
to.description: The last day of the window (see From).

events.name: Events
events.description: Every event this source has now: a list of objects with external_id (the source's own ID for it), title, start and end (a date for all-day events, with an end the day after the last day; otherwise a date-time, in Home Assistant's time zone when it has no offset), all_day, and optionally notes and location.

plan_meal.name: Plan meal
plan_meal.description: Plans a meal on Kinwall's meal planner: a recipe from the library, or just a name. Needs an admin API key.

config_entry.name: Kinwall
config_entry.description: Which Kinwall, when more than one is set up.

title.name: Title
title.description: The meal's name. Needed unless you give a recipe ID.

recipe_id.name: Recipe ID
recipe_id.description: A Kinwall recipe ID, such as the recipe_id from Import recipe.

night_screen.name: Night screen
night_screen.description: Starts or ends the Night screen on Kinwall's wall screens, for example when nobody's home. Each wall uses its own Night screen settings, and a tap still wakes it. Needs an admin API key and a Kinwall server newer than 1.1.0.

config_entry.name: Kinwall
config_entry.description: Which Kinwall, when more than one is set up.

on.name: On
on.description: On starts the Night screen; off ends it and wakes the walls.

displays.name: Wall screens
displays.description: Which wall screens: their Night screen switches (or a paired display's name or ID). Leave empty for every wall screen.

hours.name: Runs out after
hours.description: Hours until the Night screen ends by itself if nothing turns it off. Default 12.
